elements.name: young passenger at frame edge seen from behind, head turned

wrong_setting: The dense alpine conifer forest and jagged peaks read as the Alps or the Rockies, not the Ethiopian highlands. The huge single-pane window with a rail looks like a cable car or tram, not a country bus.
anatomy: The central figure stands on the window ledge or bench inside the vehicle, which is a spatially impossible placement. His legs and feet also look stiff and pasted on.
notes: Remove the standing figure from the window. Make the single edge passenger match the reference (Ethiopian, short black hair, dark jacket) with his backpack on his knees. Repaint the view as Ethiopian highland slopes seen through an ordinary bus side window.
